scope: Artificial wavelength-dependent source integrated through verified DES responses. No actual SN flux or physical source model.
source_model: L_lambda proportional to (lambda_e/5500A)^-2 times exp[-ln(2)*(2*t_e/(30day*(lambda_e/5500A)^q))^2] over 1000-20000A, zero outside. Every tested passband maps strictly inside that range.
postulates: Spectral stretch S; event stretch S^b; number conservation, fixed distance. F_lambda,o=S^-(b+2)*L_lambda,e(lambda_o/S,t_o/S^b) up to constant geometric dilution.
